hexToChar
util.hexToChar = function (
pRawString
)

Method to cast a hex-string representation created with UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW back to String.

ADC submits its response as a hex string to circumvent escaping issues between JSON, JavaScript and JavaScript containing JSON.  As a consequence, the hex string must be converted back to a normal string in order to append it to the page.

Parameter
pRawString

Hex-encoded string to convert back to a normal string.

Returns

Converted String
